Two issues in my test:
1. The "112 MiB" case was actually only 9.7 MiB (my line math: ROW is ~72 bytes × 200 = 14400 per line, × 700 = 10 MiB) ✓ so it passed and was accepted (with 140000 records — wait, 200 records × 700 = 140000 records, under the 200000 limit ✓).
2. The ">128 MiB" case was only ~13 MiB → accepted, not a capture error. My test math was wrong.

Let me fix: to exceed 128 MiB decompressed, I need line_count × 72 bytes > 128 MiB → ~1.87M rows, which also exceeds the 200000-record limit (which triggers first). Hmm! So the decompressed limit can only be exceeded with FEWER than 200000 records but each record being large (e.g., 200000 records × 700 bytes = 140 MiB). Or with big fields.

Let me construct: 199999 records each ~700 bytes → 140 MiB decompressed, compressed small (repetitive). But the record count check (200000) comes first per record... With 199999 records, we don't hit the record limit; we'd hit the 128 MiB decompressed limit while streaming ✓.

Let me make each row ~700 bytes by padding a field... but fields must be ≤131072 bytes ✓ and rows must be parseable (or rejected). Let me pad the `id` field? That would make it an invalid ID (>24 chars) → rejected, but still counted as a data record ✓ and the bytes still count toward the decompressed budget ✓. 

So: rows = 'icmp,' + 'x'*600 + ',0,1,put,...\n' ≈ 680 bytes × 190000 = 129 MiB ✓.

Let me verify the budget triggers. Note the budget check happens as bytes are read (BoundedReader) — it raises when the cumulative read exceeds 128 MiB ✓.

Let me redo the test with this construction.

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('tests/test_bounds.py'); s=p.read_text()
old = s[s.index("t = time.time()\nline = ROW * 200"):]
new = '''# The decompressed budget can only be reached with few but large records,
# because 200000 records are themselves a bound.
t = time.time()
wide = b'icmp,' + b'x' * 620 + b',0,1,put,home,1,0/i1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,2001:db8:1:1200::1,echo,,,\\n'
body = HEADER + wide * 190000
compressed = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=19).compress(body)
print('  compressed %.2f MiB, decompressed %.1f MiB' % (len(compressed) / 1048576, len(body) / 1048576))
out = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks(compressed)}]), expect_error='capture')
check('decompressed > 128 MiB', out, {'error': 'capture'}, time.time() - t)

t = time.time()
body = HEADER + wide * 100000
compressed = zstd.ZstdCompressor(level=19).compress(body)
print('  compressed %.2f MiB, decompressed %.1f MiB' % (len(compressed) / 1048576, len(body) / 1048576))
out = run(campaign(leases=[lease()], services=[], captures=[
    {'encoding': 'zstd', 'chunks': chunks(compressed)}]))
check('decompressed 68 MiB all rejected', len(out['rejected']), 100000, time.time() - t)
'''
s = s.replace(old, new)
p.write_text(s)
